title: Authorized Days of an Insurer-Approved Extension (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Posting figure.** On a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental, an extension the insurer approved is posted as an insurer-paid authorization naming the approved extension request; the extension being posted is the most recently decided insurer approval on the reservation, and the network posts only the days the documented delay supports, never more than the days the insurer approved. The authorized days are the days the insurer approved on that request.

## Which request and which figure

| Element | Read from |
|---|---|
| The extension being posted | Among the reservation's extension requests whose insurer answer is approved, the one with the latest decision date |
| Days approved | The days approved on that request |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A reservation carries three extension requests: one approved for 5 days and decided on the 6th, one denied on the 9th, and one approved for 3 days and decided on the 12th. The extension being posted is the approval decided on the 12th, the most recently decided approval, and its authorized days are 3, never more than the 3 days the insurer approved.

## Quick reference

| Most recently decided approval | Days approved | Authorized days |
|---|---|---|
| Hypothetical request A | 2 | 2 |
| Hypothetical request B | 5 | 5 |
